sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Armored Subsea Telecommunication Fiber Cables

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: France (national territory, including its exclusive economic zone for submarine cable landing)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law - French Romanist (Napoleonic code) tradition with EU law supremacy
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France-China Bilateral Investment Treaty signed 30 May 1984, in force from 19 March 1985
France-China Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement signed 26 November 2013, effective from 1 January 2015
France-United States Tax Treaty and related diplomatic notes governing cross-border cable joint ventures

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L.561-2, L.561-4 and L.561-45 to L.561-49 of the French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monetaire et financier); Article R.561-20-1 et seq. of the same code; Decret no. 2020-118 of 14 February 2020 on AML/CFT obligations; INPI Registre General des Entreprises UBO module; EU Directive (EU) 2018/843 (AMLD5) as transposed; CJEU judgment of 22 November 2022, joined cases C-37/20 and C-601/20, restricting public UBO access.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copy of the corporate shareholder's business license (certificat d'immatriculation)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Market Administration for Market Regulation, People's Republic of China

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / legal existence of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Chinese State Taxation Administration and Company Registry

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized passport copies of all ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Duly executed Power of Attorney appointing the French incorporation counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and sworn declaration of source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing credit institution (original letterhead, notarized signature)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors and authorized signatories against the United Nations consolidated sanctions list, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list (Council Regulations EU 269/2014 and 833/2014, as amended), the OFAC SDN list for all USD-denominated SWIFT payments, the French national asset-freeze list maintained by Tracfin, and global PEP databases, all in accordance with FATF Recommendation 12 and Articles L.561-10, L.561-18 and R.561-20-1 of the French Monetary and Financial Code. Enhanced due diligence is required for PEPs, non-resident corporate shareholders, state-owned shareholders and transactions financed by government letters of credit.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Portail des Formalites de l'INPI (Guichet Unique Electronique) at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr; name conflict verification against the Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) and the Registre du Commerce et des Societes (RCS) via Infogreffe.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under Articles L.123-1 and R.123-32 of the French Commercial Code, the corporate name must be expressed in Latin script in the French language; a supplementary foreign-language name is permitted but the French version prevails in all Kbis and tax filings; names composed exclusively of non-Latin characters are rejected and require sworn transliteration.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection or opposition by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce or by a rights holder, the applicant may promptly re-file on the Guichet Unique with an amended distinctive name. If a third-party opposition is lodged under Article L.712-2 of the French Intellectual Property Code, the applicant may bring a judicial claim before the competent Tribunal Judiciaire or Tribunal de Commerce within two months of notification. For errors of the official formalities portal, the applicant may request resumption of the processing under Article R.123-35 of the French Commercial Code and, if refused, appeal before the supervisory judge (juge commis au controle des registres).

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A registered office via a licensed commercial domiciliation company is permitted under Articles L.123-11-1 and R.123-136 et seq. of the French Commercial Code for the first five years, provided a formal domiciliation contract is executed and the address appears on the Kbis with the mention 'designe par le dirigeant' where applicable. However, a submarine cable manufacturing entity must also disclose a physical industrial establishment for the actual production site, and the French tax authorities will apply the effective management rule under Article 4A of the French General Tax Code to challenge any purely artificial office address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 55% for the registered office if virtual; 80% for the production site under the DREAL environmental inspection regime applicable to cable manufacturing facilities.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: INPI legal formality control fee and Guichet Unique filing charge
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Institut National de la Propriete Industrielle (INPI)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registry of Court (Greffe) fee for RCS enrolment and Kbis issuance
Publication of the incorporation notice in a legal announcements gazette (JAL)
Drafting of French SAS articles of association and preliminary legal opinion on DTA/PE exposure
UBO piercing, PEP and sanctions screening run through commercial KYC/AML databases
Preparation and legalization of the notarized apostille bundle in the shareholder's jurisdiction
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff plus apostille fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office domiciliation service for the first year
Sworn translation into French of statutes and all supporting corporate documents
Corporate bank account opening compliance fee and AML/KYC processing by the French bank
Pre-incorporation sector-specific license vetting for submarine cable activity (ARCEP landing license and ICPE environmental permit)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code, Articles L. 210-1 et seq. (commercial companies) and L. 227-1 to L. 227-20 (Société par Actions Simplifiée); applicable provisions of the Civil Code and the Monetary and Financial Code also apply.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: The competent commercial court clerk (greffe du tribunal de commerce) maintains the Trade and Companies Register (Registre du commerce et des sociétés, RCS). The incorporation application is submitted through the national company formalities portal operated by the Institut national de la propriété industrielle (INPI), the Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Electronic company-formation formalité (formerly the M0 declaration), submitted through the Guichet unique, supported by the signed articles of association and required attachments; registration results in RCS registration and issuance of a SIREN number and Kbis extract.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital applies to a SAS; capital must be fixed in the articles. At least 50% of cash contributions must be paid upon subscription, with the balance payable within five years of RCS registration. Cash contributions are deposited with a bank, notary, or other legally authorized depositary before registration; no general statutory escrow-account requirement applies. Contributions in kind are fully contributed at formation and may require a commissaire aux apports, subject to statutory exceptions.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The undersigned President and directors of [Company Name], a société par actions simplifiée in formation, resolve as follows: (1) to acknowledge and approve the subscriptions set out in the executed articles of association and confirm that the required initial cash contributions have been deposited with the designated depositary; (2) to adopt [full address] as the registered office; (3) to appoint [name] as President and [name(s), if applicable] as Directeur Général, on the terms stated in the articles or appointment instruments; and (4) to authorize the President to complete registration formalities, open the company’s operating bank account, and obtain all registrations and permits required for its activities. These resolutions take effect upon signature.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Set company particulars and prepare formation documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founders and, where engaged, a French notary or avocat; filing is later made through the INPI Guichet unique.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Select the company name, registered office, duration, corporate purpose, capital, share allocation, governance rules, President, and any other officers. Draft and sign the articles of association. Execute any required contribution-in-kind reports and appointment instruments. Arrange French translations by a sworn translator for foreign-language documents; obtain apostilles or legalization where required.
required_dossiers: Corporate shareholder registration extract and authority documents, if applicable
President and other officer identity documents and declarations of non-conviction and parentage
Contribution-in-kind documentation and commissaire aux apports report, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct inconsistencies in the articles or supporting evidence, obtain missing certified translations or authentication, and re-execute documents where signature or authority defects exist.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit initial cash capital and obtain deposit certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French bank, notary, or other depositary legally authorized to receive company formation capital.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a formation capital-deposit account, provide the signed draft articles and subscriber details, and transfer the cash subscriptions required at formation. Obtain the depositary certificate and retain it for the registration filing. The deposited funds are released to the company after registration and presentation of the Kbis extract.
required_dossiers: Draft or executed articles of association
Source-of-funds information requested by the depositary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to the depositary’s KYC or source-of-funds queries, correct subscriber information, and use another eligible depositary if account opening is declined.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d’annonces légales (JAL) or an authorized online legal-notice service in the department of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the prescribed formation notice for publication in the department where the registered office is located. Ensure that the notice matches the articles on company name, legal form, capital, registered office, corporate purpose, duration, and President. Obtain the publication certificate or attestation for the registration dossier.
required_dossiers: Company particulars consistent with the signed articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Request a corrected notice and replacement certificate if any published particulars are inaccurate; submit the corrected evidence with the registration filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submit the incorporation and beneficial-ownership filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises; examination and RCS registration by the competent commercial court clerk.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the electronic company-formation formalité, upload the signed articles and supporting documents, declare beneficial owners, pay the applicable registry and beneficial-ownership charges, and electronically sign and submit the file. Track the filing through the portal and provide any requested originals or additional evidence in the specified form.
required_dossiers: Officer identity documents and declarations of non-conviction and parentage
Contribution-in-kind report or waiver justification, if applicable
Power of attorney, if filed by a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Submit the requested correction or missing document within the portal deadline; reconcile the filing with the articles and published notice. If rejected, correct the stated defect and refile, or use the applicable review or appeal process before the competent registry authority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete post-registration corporate and tax formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique, competent tax office (Service des impôts des entreprises), and the company’s bank.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Download the Kbis extract and SIREN/SIRET details, provide the Kbis to the depositary to release capital, and activate the operating bank account. Confirm tax and VAT registration details, maintain the statutory registers and share records, and file any required amendments through the Guichet unique.
required_dossiers: Statutory registers and share subscription records
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct erroneous identification or activity data through the Guichet unique and notify the relevant tax office or bank; make any required post-registration amendment filing.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No general industrial licensing board or sector-wide manufacturing permit applies solely because the company manufactures submarine fiber-optic cables. The prefect of the department where the facility is located is the competent authority for applicable ICPE procedures, supported by the DREAL (Direction régionale de l’environnement, de l’aménagement et du logement); workplace and construction requirements are administered by the relevant labor, planning, and building authorities.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No universal operating or manufacturing license. Depending on site activities and thresholds, the facility may require an ICPE declaration, registration, or environmental authorization under the Environmental Code, together with applicable planning and building permits.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry for Ecological Transition, with the departmental prefect as competent environmental-authority decision-maker and the DREAL providing technical review, as applicable.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Project-specific screening under the Environmental Code. An environmental assessment is required where the project falls within Annex I of the applicable EIA rules or is determined, including after case-by-case examination, to be likely to have significant environmental effects. An ICPE environmental authorization project generally requires an environmental impact assessment; lower-tier declaration or registration projects are not automatically exempt from other environmental review.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No single cable-manufacturing threshold applies across all sites. Applicable ICPE nomenclature, permit or registration prescriptions, water-law requirements, and local discharge permits determine limits. The operator must obtain authorization where required before discharging to surface water or sewer, comply with prescribed pollutant and monitoring limits, control VOC and process emissions under applicable ICPE prescriptions and the EU Industrial Emissions framework where relevant, and classify, segregate, store, and transfer hazardous and non-hazardous waste through authorized channels with required traceability.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Before operation, obtain applicable planning permission and building authorization, comply with the French Construction and Housing Code and fire-safety rules applicable to the building’s use, and complete required fire-protection measures and inspections. Structural design and floor loading must be certified as appropriate for machinery and storage. The employer must complete workplace risk assessment (DUERP), implement occupational health and safety measures, arrange required occupational health services, and satisfy labor-inspection and worker-safety obligations. Additional fire-service or public-access-building approvals apply if the premises fall within the relevant classification.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), Ministry of Economy and Finance, 10 rue du Centre, Noisy-le-Grand; corporate portal: impots.gouv.fr; single-window incorporation e-filing at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr (Guichet Unique administered by INPI); customs and export clearance authority: Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI) via the DELTA-X platform (douane.gouv.fr); non-resident VAT registration through the Service des impôts des entreprises non-résidentes (DENI, Paris).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: At incorporation, the Guichet Unique transmits the SAS registration to INSEE, which issues SIREN, SIRET and the APE/NAF code 27.32Z; within 5 to 10 business days the DGFiP allocates the French intra-Community VAT number in the format FR + 2-digit control key + 9-digit SIREN. Existing SAS entities file modifications via the Guichet Unique or form 3726 at the competent SIE. A foreign company acting through a French fixed establishment without a legal seat files under Article 286 quater CGI at the DENI to obtain a SIRET and a French VAT number within 4 to 6 weeks. Before the first customs export declaration, the manufacturer must also obtain an EORI number (starting FR) from the DGDDI.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the SAS is mandatorily subject to French corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés) under Article 206-1 CGI at 25% (reduced 15% rate on the first EUR 42,500 of taxable profits for SMEs); no pass-through option exists. Under Article 209-I CGI territoriality, profits attributable to a foreign permanent establishment are generally excluded unless the worldwide-consolidation option is exercised; the SAS manufacturing profits are taxable in France.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists in French law; SAS tax identity is fixed and non- electable. Available statutory elections: (1) fiscal integration (intégration fiscale) under Article 223 A CGI for a group head holding at least 95% of French subsidiaries; (2) the Article 209 A CGI option to include foreign branch income on a worldwide basis (irrevocable 5-year term; the 'bénéfice mondial' variant requires ministerial authorization); (3) waiver of the VAT franchise under Article 293 F CGI; (4) choice between the régime réel normal and régime simplifié d'imposition for filing; and (5) mandatory hybrid-mismatch disclosure under Article 212 bis II CGI and DAC6 (form 2258-SD), due within 45 days of any hybrid arrangement — no opt-out election is granted; penalties reach EUR 1,500 per missing arrangement plus 5% of the value of relevant transactions.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: TVA (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée) — French Value Added Tax implementing Directive 2006/112/EC
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Franchise en base de TVA: EUR 91,900 annual turnover for principal supplies of goods (2025 barème, revalued annually) and EUR 36,800 for services; for this subsea-cable export manufacturer, VAT identification is mandatory from the first transaction because exports are exempt-with-credit: the SAS must hold a VAT number to zero-rate export invoices, to recover input VAT (annual input credits exceeding EUR 760 refundable via form 3519-SD), and to report intra-EU dispatches; registration is also required where intra-EU acquisitions exceed EUR 10,000 per calendar year.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France mandates nationwide B2B e-invoicing from 1 September 2026: all VAT-taxable persons must receive e-invoices and large/mid-sized enterprises must issue them; issuance becomes compulsory for SMEs and micro-enterprises from 1 September 2027. Invoices must be transmitted via a certified Plateforme de Dématérialisation Partenaire (PDP) or the public Portail Public de Facturation (PPF) in Factur-X (hybrid PDF/XML), UBL or CII structured formats, each carrying the SIREN-derived unique invoice identifier and both parties' VAT numbers; transactional e-reporting to the DGFiP occurs within one business day of the invoice event, covering sales, purchases and payment data; there is no pre-issuance fiscal clearance stamp or per-invoice digital duty regime, but transmission integrity and the platform audit trail constitute the mandatory VAT evidence, with a EUR 15 fixed penalty per non-compliant invoice under Article 1737 CGI.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Definitive export of armored subsea fiber cables out of EU customs territory qualifies for 0% VAT (exemption-with-credit) under Article 262-I-1° CGI where the seller proves physical dispatch outside the EU and transfer of ownership; the invoice must mention 'Exonération TVA – article 262-I-1° du CGI' and be backed by the registered customs export declaration. Services directly connected to the export, including offshore cable laying, engineering and commissioning outside the EU, are exempt under Article 262-I-2° CGI; B2B services supplied to non-EU telecom operators are outside French VAT under Article 259-1° CGI. Deliveries to another EU Member State (cross-border cable landings) rely on the intra-Community exemption under Article 262 ter CGI, conditional on the customer's valid EU VAT number (VIES verification). Supplies delivered and installed within French territory, including French territorial waters, remain taxable at 20%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration — DAU (Document Administratif Unique) / SAD lodged via DELTA-X with exit confirmation stamp
Bill of Lading (ocean or multimodal) or Air Waybill naming the non-EU consignee and final cable destination
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank SWIFT credit confirmation or government Letter of Credit drawdown record evidencing receipt of export proceeds on the French account
Commercial invoice (original) stating Article 262-I-1° CGI export VAT exemption, Incoterms and full shipment particulars
Packing list and transport insurance certificate corroborating the export movement
EORI number (FR) and, where applicable, REX (Registered Exporter) number for preferential origin declarations
Non-EU customer's purchase order and delivery acceptance protocol evidencing transfer of title and risk
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export transactions are a declared priority of the DGFiP fiscal control programme; the DGDDI export declaration file is automatically cross-checked against VAT returns, and any missing customs or banking proof triggers re-taxation of the export at 20% with monthly late-payment interest (0.20% per month in 2025, Article 1727 CGI) and penalties of 40% (gross negligence) or 80% (fraud) under Article 1729 CGI. Non-repatriation of proceeds within 180 days breaches Article L112-4 of the Code monétaire et financier and the DGDDI exchange-control rules, exposing the SAS to civil sanctions of 1x to 2x the un-repatriated amount and suspension of export authorizations. Criminal exposure includes Article 1741 CGI tax fraud (up to EUR 500,000 fine and 5 years' imprisonment) and customs smuggling penalties under Articles 414-2 and 415 of the Code des douanes (confiscation of the cable shipment plus a fine of 1x to 2x its value). The standard three-year VAT reassessment window under Article L176 LPF extends to ten years for hidden activities or organized fraudulent export schemes; input VAT refunds on export activity remain claimable monthly or quarterly via form 3519-SD.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France, as a founding Eurozone member, maintains full convertibility for both current and capital accounts; profit remittances, dividends, and capital repatriation face no regulatory hurdles for qualifying French SAS entities meeting standard tax and reporting obligations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or forced conversion of export proceeds; French entities must declare all export revenues under VAT and corporate tax regimes, with proceeds freely repatriable subject to standard AML/KYC verification and tax filing requirements.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Limited viability for offshore digital EMIs; French regulations mandate licensed banking intermediaries for cross-border payments, restricting fintech platforms such as Revolut Business to supplementary services only after full KYC and potential additional licensing.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote KYC and digital onboarding permitted for established French SAS entities using verified electronic documentation; directors and beneficial owners may be required to attend in-person or video interviews during initial setup and annual reviews.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or PEP screening adverse hits on directors, beneficial owners, or related parties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source of wealth and funds documentation, clean background certificates, and legal entity verification bundle

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership structure linked to high-risk jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Ultimate beneficial ownership declaration, corporate ownership chart, and enhanced due diligence reports

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound transfers via SWIFT MT103 or SEPA Instant for EUR-denominated capital; employ purpose codes such as 'CAP' for equity injections or 'TRA' for trade settlements, supported by board resolutions, invoices, and ownership verification.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing through SWIFT MT103 or issuance of Commercial Letters of Credit routed via correspondent banks; subsea cable project disbursements, particularly under government contracts, typically processed via LC with precise purpose codes including 'LC PAYMENT'.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (liasse fiscale, form no. 2065-SD) covering profit declaration and tax appendices
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via the professional online filing portal (Espace professionnel / EFI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By the 2nd business day after 1 May for a 31 December year-end (usually between 2 and 6 May; calendar shifts apply); off-calendar year-ends filed within 3 months of fiscal close
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic 10% late-filing increase plus 0.2% monthly late interest; 40% increase if not filed within 30 days of formal notice; 80% penalty for deliberate omission; taxation d'office may be applied and criminal fines for legal entities up to €15,000 may be pursued.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements filing (dépôt des comptes annuels: balance sheet, income statement and notes)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry) transmitted via the INPI Guichet Unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 7 months of fiscal year-end (by 31 July for a 31 December year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Court injunction procedure with daily coercive fine (astreinte); civil amende up to €7,500 per legal entity; director criminal exposure up to €30,000; repeated non-filing supports registry strike-off action.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial owner register declaration (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs; RBE / UBO) and register maintenance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via Guichet Unique (publicly displayed in the Trade and Companies Register)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of any ownership or control change; no fixed annual calendar date - register must be kept permanently current and is verified by the registry upon each filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fine €7,500 and 6 months imprisonment for natural persons; €37,500 fine for legal entities for omitted or inaccurate declaration; registry may block other filings until corrected.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual business premises contribution (cotisation foncière des entreprises; CFE) - local business property franchise tax
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP local tax office (SIE) of the establishment's location
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payment by 15 December of the assessment year; initial declaration (form 1447-C) within 3 months of opening or moving a business establishment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late-payment increase plus monthly 0.2% late interest after 15 December; enforced recovery against business assets; non-declaration of a taxable establishment attracts the same penalties.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent statutory auditor (Commissaire aux Comptes) mandatory when at least two of three thresholds are exceeded at fiscal year-end: balance sheet total > €4,000,000; net turnover excluding VAT > €8,000,000; average workforce > 50 employees. Mandatory for SAS controlling one or more subsidiaries when the group meets the same thresholds; also mandatory by court order upon shareholder request.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général per ANC Regulation 2014-03 as amended) applied through Articles L123-12 and following of the French Commercial Code; IFRS mandatory only for consolidated accounts of listed companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France imposes continuous register currency rather than an annual UBO confirmation return: every share transfer or change in beneficial ownership must be declared to the RBE within 30 calendar days via the Guichet Unique. The registry systematically cross-checks the RBE when annual accounts are filed and will require an updated declaration as a precondition to accepting the filing. A signed paper copy of the UBO statement must be kept at the registered office.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Registre des délibérations (corporate minute books recording shareholders' and president's decisions)
Registre des mouvements de titres (share transfer register recording all share subscriptions and transfers)
Physical copy of the RBE / UBO declaration filed with the Greffe

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$300 - US$1,200 per year (commercial domiciliation services for SAS)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$6,000 - US$35,000 per year (certified audit fee depending on consolidation scope and international operations)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: R&D tax credit (maximum 5% of qualifying R&D expenses), accelerated depreciation for certain assets, no specific tax holidays for subsea cable manufacturing
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: unlimited (deduction capped at €1 billion per year)

tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 2nd month following fiscal year end (February 28 for calendar year ending December 31)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable profit after all adjustments and deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Resident companies only; non-residents file if French-source income exceeds thresholds

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions for operating expenses, depreciation, provisions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Applicable to French branch or permanent establishment income

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: 0.5% of tax due per month of delay, minimum €50, maximum 25% of tax due

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Obtain Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) from home jurisdiction and submit to French tax authorities for DTA application and reduced rate withholding
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory domestic rate: 0%; Treaty rates: 0-5% for royalties, 0-10% for interest (e.g. 5% US substantial ownership, 15% otherwise)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: €1 million for local file; €50 million for master file
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Not fully adopted; compliance enforced via General Anti-Avoidance Rule (GAAR), CFC rules, and beneficial ownership requirements

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Understatement of taxable income or false declarations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalty up to 5 years imprisonment and fine up to 500% of evaded tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability, civil restitution, and possible imprisonment

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Establishing or maintaining a shell entity without economic substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal sanctions including fines and corporate dissolution; up to 5 years imprisonment
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing the corporate veil; personal tax liability and criminal exposure

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to perform KYC, CDD, or suspicious transaction reporting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to €1 million or 5% of turnover; criminal penalties
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal fines and criminal prosecution for management
